title: Colourings of a 12-slot rotating tray with no equal neighbours
notes: Traps: the ring closes (slot 12 touches slot 1), and some valid fillings repeat under rotation by 3 or 6 slots, so dividing the 804 valid fillings by 12 (67) is wrong; Burnside gives 70. broken/: 67 divides by 12, 91 ignores the wrap-around adjacency and divides by 12, 41 also identifies mirror images.
